verdict.rationale: The evidence covers real-time authorization webhooks, spending controls (merchant category, MID), risk scores, and wallet support, but there is no evidence that Stripe surfaces MCC codes, enhanced merchant data, wallet/entry-mode details, or partial-approval/incremental-auth signals within the authorization payload itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC field, enhanced merchant metadata, wallet/entry-mode indicators, and partial-approval/incremental-auth signal support in the authorization object.
